title: ProBuild Points Ledger Standard: Reversal, Expiry and Forfeiture
content:
Perks points on a Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership leave the points account in three ways besides redemption: they are reversed when the purchase they were earned on is returned, they expire with age, and they are forfeited when the membership closes.

## Standard

**1. Reversal on a return.** When a purchase is returned, the points earned on the returned part are reversed in proportion to the pre-tax amount returned, rounded down to a whole point, against the original spend entry: the points earned on the purchase, multiplied by the pre-tax amount returned and divided by the pre-tax amount of the purchase. Where the tier allows a reversal to take the balance below zero, the reversal applies in full even if the balance falls below zero.

**2. Expiry.** Points expire the tier's expiry period, in calendar months, after their earn date, on the same day of the month, or on the last day of the month when that day does not exist. They expire oldest first, as points expired on the aged-out basis.

**3. Forfeiture on closure.** When a membership closes and the tier provides that closure forfeits points, every remaining point is forfeited, as points expired on the membership-closed basis.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

**A partial return.** A purchase of USD 800.00 pre-tax earned 1000 points. Goods worth USD 250.00 pre-tax are returned. 1000 multiplied by 250.00 and divided by 800.00 is 312.5; rounded down, 312 points are reversed against the original purchase.

**A reversal larger than the balance.** The membership's balance stands at 200 points when the 312 points above are reversed, at a tier that allows the balance to go below zero. The reversal applies in full and the balance becomes 112 points below zero.

**Expiry dates.**

| Hypothetical earn date | Hypothetical expiry period | Expiry date |
|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2025 | 12 months | 15 March 2026 |
| 31 August 2025 | 18 months | 28 February 2027, the last day of that month, since February 2027 has no 31st |
| 30 June 2025 | 24 months | 30 June 2027 |

**Closure.** A membership closes with 4300 points remaining, at a tier that provides that closure forfeits points. All 4300 points are forfeited on the membership-closed basis.
